title: Anionex/banana-slides builds editable presentations from prompts and source material
friendlyTitle: Banana Slides turns ideas and templates into editable presentations
summary: Banana Slides is an AGPL-3.0 TypeScript application for generating presentations from a sentence, outline or page description, with support for uploaded templates and source material. The fast-rising project had more than 15,000 stars when checked.
friendlySummary: This trending app can make slides from a prompt, outline, template or uploaded material. It can export an editable PowerPoint file.
whyItMatters: It provides a self-hostable starting point for AI-assisted slide workflows where users need to revise specific regions and export an editable PowerPoint file. Review its model requirements and AGPL obligations before organisational deployment.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Try it to create a first draft of a presentation quickly, then edit the result. Check its AI model needs and AGPL licence before using it across a business.
